_about: The simplified Outgrow window (25 Oct): one switch that shows or hides Outgrow (every building keeps its type), one status line, the brush (Off is a type), the Zones and Edit types tabs, Reset all at the bottom. A street grows and is outgrown; the window; the switch off (gardens go, the window says hidden); on again (they come back); the Edit types tab. Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/outgrow-window.json -Who outgrow-window
